extName.message: Sava — pixel art companion for AI chats

extDesc.message: Sava, a pixel art character who reacts to Claude and Gemini replies with 18 expressions. Free and private.

btnSend.message: Send Sava's instruction in this chat

toastDraft.message: I added the instruction after your draft. Review it and send when you're ready.

toastNoField.message: I couldn't find the message box.

toastNoWrite.message: I couldn't type in the message box.

toastCopied.message: $1 I copied the instruction: just paste it into the chat (Ctrl+V).

opt_sub.message: Sava reacts to AI replies on Claude, Gemini and other AI chats. Everything runs in your browser.

opt_instrHint.message: Click 💬 on Sava to send it in the open chat, or paste it once into Claude's preferences or Gemini's saved info. The AI starts acting as Sava and tags the emotion of each reply; the extension reads the tag, changes the expression and hides the tag from the chat.

opt_mapHint.message: Each emotion points to one of the character's expressions. Click a row to try it on the character in the corner. You can create new emotions (e.g. shock → Surprised).

opt_typing.message: Pay attention while I type and look thoughtful after I send

opt_keywords.message: Detect by keywords when there is no tag

opt_hideTag.message: Hide the [emo:…] tag from the chat

opt_showLabel.message: Show the emotion name under the character

opt_testHint.message: Write a sample reply and see which emotion comes out.

opt_sample.message: Oh, thank you... now I'm blushing 😳

opt_privText.message: Chat text is read only to pick the expression and is never sent anywhere. The extension only asks for storage and access to the sites listed above.

opt_tablet.message: Also show Sava on a USB tablet (Sava Tablet app)

opt_sitesHint.message: Claude and Gemini work out of the box. The other sites ask for permission to run when you turn them on.

opt_sitesReload.message: Done! Reload the site's tab for Sava to appear.

opt_reactUser.message: React to the tone of my messages (thanks = happy, scolding = sad)

opt_reactLimit.message: Look exhausted when the AI hits its usage limit

toastLimit.message: Phew… the AI hit its usage limit. Time for a little break? 😵‍💫
